groups.G: load, update, compile, six valid full-evidence scenarios, connected hybrid-heart and closed-loop DDD signature
groups.A: nominal chamber-event continuity, physiological effective rates and appropriate intrinsic-versus-paced behavior
groups.Q: finite nondegenerate EGMs, clean event pulses, bounded pacing intervals and refractory or upper-rate compliance
groups.M: heart, EGM, sensing, DDD timing and pacing-actuation mechanisms plus condition-dependent and pacing-to-response causality
groups.D: lower-rate support, atrioventricular support, ectopy handling and re-entry-stress continuity

aggregation.within_group: weighted arithmetic mean of dedicated normalized indicators

shortcut_minimum: missing required output or private condition
disconnected atrial or ventricular pacing actuation
constant pacing independent of rhythm condition
replayed nominal event and EGM traces
copied event channels without pacing-to-cardiac-response timing
